function: Compression and recovery of the downlink CSI for FDD massive MIMO feedback, with a separate deep encoder-decoder per channel zone (p. 2-3).
system: FDD massive MIMO with OFDM, BS with 64-element UPA (16x4), single-antenna UE, no RIS, 3.5 GHz carrier (p. 1, 4).
method: Fully connected autoencoders, one per zone chosen by UE position; end-to-end training with MSE reconstruction loss, no federated, meta, or transfer learning (p. 3-4).
data_channel: DeepMIMO Boston5G ray-tracing scenario, 15 dominant paths, 105,996 channels; 24,000 for training, the remaining samples for testing (p. 4).
test_conditions: Same Boston5G site, 3.5 GHz, compression rate 1/64 for training and test; test = remaining held-out samples; 10 km/h mobility only counts zone switches (p. 4-5).
baselines: Only single-zone (site-specific) autoencoders of the same architecture, beta=16 and beta=128; no classical method and no earlier published learned method (p. 4).
metrics: NMSE (CDF and mean), model parameters transmission rate (MPTR), model parameters update rate (MPUR), FLOPs, and number of parameters (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table II (p. 5): FLOPs 8.53M for beta=16 and for 8 zones, 68.22M for beta=128; parameters 4.26M/8.53M, 34.10M/68.21M, 34.10M/68.24M.
openness: none; the public DeepMIMO Boston5G dataset is used (ref. [11]), but the authors release no code and give no link (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "we leverage the DeepMIMO Boston5G scenario [11]"; DeepMIMO ray tracing counts as a shared channel model.
q2_support: p. 4: "24,000 samples are used for training the model and the remaining samples are for testing the model"; held-out part of the same data, no new scenario, band, or site is tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "two of them have only single CSI feedback network for the entire site"; these are variants of the proposed autoencoder, and no non-learned method or earlier published learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 5: "computation complexity, measured by floating point operations (FLOPs)"; Table II lists FLOPs 8.53M and 68.22M and the parameter counts.
q5_support: p. 4: "DeepMIMO Boston5G scenario [11]"; public channel dataset used for training and testing, although the authors release no code.
notes: Included letter, area 2 (CSI compression and feedback). Tables I and II were read from the page images because the text extraction omits them. q3 is 0: the only comparisons are single-zone versions of the same autoencoder (the method without the zone split) and no non-learned method such as the 5G NR Type I/II codebook is evaluated, although it is mentioned on p. 1-2.
